card.name: Inside rare or foreign word spellings
card.fires_on: A short piece in the middle of a rare, misspelled-looking or transliterated word, such as Lao script, Hebrew or Arabic names, or an unusual English word split into parts. It fires on the unexpected middle piece, not on common words.
